notes.title: Patch 1.2.0
notes.notes:
Changes:

[previewyoutube=a2NC-V5aRmQ;full][/previewyoutube]
Lots of visual improvements
Added new bonus room
Many bonus rooms that previously required items from multiple floors will now generate all of the items on the same floor.
It is now possible to unequip one item at a time
Water monsters have had there move distance capped.
Ghosts-Small have had their move speed reduced slightly

notes.title: Patch 1.1.0
notes.notes:
Changes:

Added glow effect to things that should probably glow
Added bad luck protection for pots
Child owl is less likely to spawn
Visual update to the Celestium
Pots should now be more consistent with drops

Reduced tick rate of Ice Patches dropped from Trail of Frost 
Increased tick rate of Magma Patches dropped from Molten Arrow 

Fixed a bug that would cause the music to stop playing when using portals in the Celestium
Fixed a bug that would cause the owl to not add enough feathers to the dungeon to complete
Fixed other bugs and issues.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Changes:

Added leader boards for fastest clear and highest level cleared 

Added new upgrades
George will now display the arrow type he will shoot next
Richard base sword length increased
Dilon base slash size increased

Most enemy projectiles have had their travel speed reduced
Most melee mobs have had there walk speed slightly reduced
Halos have had there travel range limited, can no longer yeet themselves across the map.
Halo and Demon Portal have had their spawn rates reduced

Swamp monster jump attack should be easier to dodge
Demon slash attack should be easier to dodge
Evil Eye shoots less lazers during spin attack

Fixed bugs and issues.

notes.title: Patch 0.13.0
notes.notes:
Changes:

Added another random event
Added mouseover tooltips for items found in the dungeon
Added map icon to pause menu
Added new adventurer Allison:

Channels beams of light and can explode in a bust of light.

Updated spider boss
Other minor adjustments and bug fixes

notes.title: Patch 0.12.0
notes.notes:
Changes:

Added achievements
Added two new cool secret thingies
Added new encounter at the end of the boss rush game mode
Added mouse sensitivity option under general options
Added cool new death animation!
Added the ability to change bed material
Added a lot more possible room layouts
Added a new stat on the scoreboard for Suzy

How many snow balls have been thrown in last five seconds

Added new upgrade for Suzy   , Fresh Snow (Rare)  - Standing in Snow Storm reduces Snowballs mana cost
Added new upgrade for George , Magic Arrow (Rare) - Grants a small shield when it hits an enemy
Added new upgrade for Charles, Bigger Rockets ( Common ) - Rocket explosion size increased
Added new upgrade for Richard, Empowered Crits (Rare) - Increases sword length during Crits. Increases crit chance.

notes.title: Minor Patch 0.11.2
notes.notes:
Changes:

NEW Boss Heart ( Generic, Rare ): Killing a boss heals you to full, increases max health
On the first time playing a character, a menu will pop up explaining the adventurers abilities
Adjustments to shadow ghost boss void zones
Reduced pot-breaking sound modifier from 2.0 -> 1.0, not sure why it was this high 
Added back a bonus room that should have been there all along
Other minor adjustments

notes.title: Patch 11.0
notes.notes:
Changes:

At least one new upgrade for all adventurers.
Added Endless mode, play until your heart's content.
New boss in the deep sea.
New adventurer Tina, solve the secret code to unlock her

Casts Shadow Bolts and throws a Shadow Orb that will inflict Shadow Disease on enemies.

All emblems now actually do something.
Fixed various bugs and issues, mostly with things being drawn in the wrong order.
Other things I probably don't remember

notes.title: Patch 0.10.0
notes.notes:
Changes:

Players will now be prompted to adjust gamma on first launch
There is now a confirmation screen before resetting a save slot
Portals can no longer be interacted with if when there is an item or unlock in the room
Adjustments to the tutorial
Adjustments to 'end-game'

Now requires you to find three 'stones' that will unlock the true ending

Boss rush has been added back, find the red stone to unlock
All bosses will now start asleep and be put back to sleep on player death
Improvements to visual fidelity
Various bug fixes
Other changes not listed here

notes.title: Patch 0.1.0
notes.notes:
You may need to restart the steam client to receive this update.

//~~ CHANGES~~//
- Made enemies _reset_ on player death, some mobs reset more than others
	- Bosses don't reset health
	- Some mobs may not reset properly
	- This wasn't 100% completely tested, mileage may vary
- Made 'Tab' / 'M' also close the map when it's open
- Made 'U' also closes the choose upgrade menu
- Made naming conventions for adventurers more consistent
- Made spiders go slightly slower
- Made spiders not jump on top of each other
- Made visual improvements to player inventory ( pending upgrades, silver keys, feathers ... )
- Made it much less likely ( probably impossible ) for a boss room to spawn immediately next to the spawn room
- Made item drops and enemy spawns use different colors
- Made it clearer which rooms have adjacent rooms and which ones don't.
- Made better visual for witches 'Shadow Blast'
- Made walls more visible on 'demonic' level
- Made spawn rooms more interesting
- Made visual cue for when unable to cast a spell due to not enough mana
- Made improvements to victory screen
- Made some hitboxes better
- Made a few more enemy patterns

- Fixed visual issue with silver key unlock animation
- Fixed heart and upgrade spawning on each other if an enemy drops both
- Fixed a bug that cause the victory screen to not show
- Fixed an issue causing less than ideal random distribution of bosses
- Fixed various enemies not being affected by slows and stuns

//~~ ADVENTURERS ~~//

*** NEW ADVENTURER ***
- Suzy
	- Shoots snowballs and can summon a snow storm in front of her

- Bob ( formerly Keizei )
	- Added new rare upgrade, 'After taste': Fire Breath will cast again for free after a short delay at the original location for half damage.

- George
	- Made new rare upgrade, 'Rock Arrow': Every 4th arrow deals more damage and travels slower
	- Made new common upgrade, 'Faster Arrows': Increases the base speed of arrows
	- Slowed base mana regen rate

- Charles ( formerly Jong Su )
	- Made new rare upgrade, 'Vampiric Spikes': Spikes now have a chance to steal a small amount of health when they hit
	- Made new common upgrade, 'Better Spikes': reduces cooldown of spikes
	- Made 'More Spikes' Upgrade Rare. New Max is 2
	- Reduced spikes extended range
	- Slowed base mana regen rate
	- Increased spike hit cooldown

//~~ BOSSES ~~//
- Made cool new Boat Boss, it does tricks
- Made Djinn boss
- Made snow boulders on snowman boss target player more aggresive and other adjustments
- Made Sand Wurm boss have less health
